evidenceClasses.assumed: Parameter value taken from literature or a scenario, not measured here.
evidenceClasses.computational-hypothesis: Statistical outlier; unverified candidate for inspection.
evidenceClasses.illustrative: Procedural visual detail; never used by analysis or physics.
evidenceClasses.measured: Elevation posts from the native DEM (or filtered decimations of it).
evidenceClasses.model-detected: Output of a registered model on measured data; heuristic confidence.

horizon.purpose: Shadow / horizon / line-of-sight ray marching (renderer and simulator use the same grid)

missingData: No orthoimage (LROC NAC/WAC) is packaged; surface shading is computed from the DEM under SPICE illumination, not observed reflectance.
No geologic, compositional, spectral or rock-abundance map is packaged for this footprint.
No measured regolith mechanical properties at this site; terramechanics uses documented literature parameters (assumed).
Terrain beyond the 26 km source raster is not modelled as an occluder.
name: Mons Mouton plateau (PGDA Site20v2)

pyramid.method: Level 5 = native 5 m pixel values on the local AEQD grid (all-valid area-average reprojection). Coarser levels = Gaussian prefilter (sigma = posting/2) and decimation. Geometric error = max |bilinear tile surface - native pixels| within the tile.

referenceFrame.verticalDatum: Height above the 1 737 400 m reference sphere (PGDA LOLA)
referenceFrame.worldFrame: Cartesian ENU tangent frame at the site centre (curvature applied)

source.citation: Barker et al. 2021, Planet. Space Sci., doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
